content: Progress tracking features: dedicated weight trackers (Happy Scale, Libra, Bodly roundup) treat trend smoothing (moving average) as the key feature because daily weight is noisy; progress photos and body measurements are standard in MacroFactor and MyFitnessPal analytics. MacroFactor markets sophisticated weight trending (filtered trend weight, goal forecast) as a core differentiator. Linking photos to same-day weight and measurements is rare; most apps keep photos as a loose gallery.
